ahfarmer/calculator.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
ahfarmer/calculator.reason: react-scripts >= 3.4.1 exits its dev server when stdin ends unless CI=true; the plan never sets it, and the exit 0 is then reported as COMPLETED.

nuxt/starter.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
nuxt/starter.reason: No ref selection: the default branch `templates` is not the application; the app lives on `v3`.

sveltejs/realworld.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
sveltejs/realworld.reason: pnpm forwards a literal `--`, so `pnpm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0` never reaches vite as options (PORT_BOUND_TO_LOCALHOST); and ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE is classified as a generic install failure instead of a runtime version, so the deterministic Node 22 repair never fires and a model call is spent. The repository's own pnpm-lock.yaml is also broken (duplicated mapping key).

gothinkster/angular-realworld-example-ap.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
gothinkster/angular-realworld-example-ap.reason: The Angular plan appends `--disable-host-check`, which the current Angular CLI (21) rejects: `Unknown argument: disable-host-check`. The diagnosis quoted husky's install-time `git command not found` instead.

jellydn/fastify-starter.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
jellydn/fastify-starter.reason: The server binds `process.env.SERVER_HOSTNAME ?? '127.0.0.1'`; the variable it reads for its bind address is never discovered or set.

fastify/demo.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
fastify/demo.reason: Every MySQL readiness check fails (`mysqladmin ping` without `-u root` runs as OS user `mysql` and is denied), so a healthy MySQL is reported as not starting. The run itself then fails on `tsx --env-file=.env` with no .env — which was diagnosed WRONG_RUNTIME_VERSION from npm's EBADENGINE *warnings*.

dan5py/turborepo-shadcn-ui.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
dan5py/turborepo-shadcn-ui.reason: A workspace with one runnable package is planned from that package alone: npm (the package has no lockfile or packageManager), installed in apps/docs, where `workspace:*` cannot resolve. The root's pnpm-lock.yaml, packageManager and install were ignored.

nsidnev/fastapi-realworld-example-app.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
nsidnev/fastapi-realworld-example-app.reason: poetry.lock is ignored: dependencies install by name, unpinned, pydantic 2 arrives, and `BaseSettings` has moved.

nrwl/nx-examples.label: DEVLAUNCH_BUG
nrwl/nx-examples.reason: Detected as Angular at the root, so `yarn run start -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200 --disable-host-check` — Yarn 4 forwards the `--`, and the flag no longer exists. Install then OOMs at the 2955 MB ceiling and Nx fails with `WorkspaceContext is not a constructor`. Partly the size of the repository.

ljlm0402/typescript-express-starter.label: REPO_FAILURE
ljlm0402/typescript-express-starter.reason: A project-generator CLI, not an application. COMPLETED (ran and exited 0, opened no port) is the correct answer.

max-pfeiffer/uvicorn-poetry-fastapi-proj.label: REPO_FAILURE
max-pfeiffer/uvicorn-poetry-fastapi-proj.reason: A cookiecutter template: the application directory is literally `{{cookiecutter.project_slug}}` and its pyproject.toml is not valid TOML until rendered. A poor corpus choice for 'a Poetry project'.

miguelgrinberg/microblog.label: UNSUPPORTED_BY_CONTRACT
miguelgrinberg/microblog.reason: Pins a multidict with no Python 3.12 wheel, which fails to build from source; DevLaunch ships one Python.

sadrozzy/Bun-React-Template.label: UNSUPPORTED_BY_CONTRACT
sadrozzy/Bun-React-Template.reason: Its dev script is `bunx --bun vite`: the Bun binary is required and DevLaunch ships none. The failure (`bunx: not found`, then a model call) does not say so.

patelharsh9797/bun-hono-app.label: UNSUPPORTED_BY_CONTRACT
patelharsh9797/bun-hono-app.reason: Runs on the Bun runtime (`bun run --hot`). DevLaunch ships no Bun; the report is a bare `bun: not found`.
